outcome: Clinical characteristics of pregnancies complicated by placenta previa
cohort: 182 singleton pregnancies complicated by placenta previa at gestational weeks >24, including 23 IVF pregnancies and 159 unassisted pregnancies
finding: While placenta previa in unassisted pregnancies is likely associated with previous Cesarean deliveries, it appears more 'sporadic' in IVF pregnancies and may complicate any index pregnancy.
